repos.name: trailhq/Graft
repos.description: Turn docs into a structured context graph that AI agents read from before working and contribute learnings back to.
repos.one_liner: A knowledge management platform that transforms unstructured documentation into structured context graphs for AI agents.
bullets: Uses graph-based data structures to map relationships between technical documentation and project context.
Provides a persistent memory layer for AI agents, allowing them to retrieve accurate information and contribute new learnings.
Reduces hallucination in agentic workflows by grounding AI responses in verified project-specific data.
Essential infrastructure for enterprises scaling agentic automation across complex codebases.
